collection_notes: Three raw profiles precede publication of four new diagnostic/evidence files; the live tree changes by four items afterward. All record hashes remain identical.
One sample per traversal configuration; warm cache, fixed order, ordinary applications open. Not a randomized compiler or coverage comparison.
The Xcode accessibility query lasted 1288 seconds. Coverage traversal completed in the background before the query returned; this does not create a 1288-second traversal sample.
Three initial custom-harness compilation attempts fail on an actor return of non-Sendable Any; passing Data across isolation fixes only the diagnostic. No production or test expectations change.
Native catalog timing disables journal/Spotlight/persistence/UI; it is not the signed sandboxed application.
One logging attempt with OS_ACTIVITY_DT_MODE=YES still leaves debug disabled; the live log observer is what verifies debug-enabled emission.
